description: Proposed single storey rear extension, basement extension with front and rear lightwells
decision_conditions: The proposed ground floor rear extension by reason of its size and scale,&nbsp; would result in a harmful impact on the amenities of the neighbouring occupiers by way of a loss of outlook, loss of daylight and sunlight (specifically to No.24 West Bank), and would have an overbearing impact.&nbsp; As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies D6 (Housing quality and standards) of the London Plan (2021), policy LP2 (Development and Amenity) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).&nbsp;

The proposed basement, rear extension and rear lightwell, by reason of their size, depth and detailed design, results in a disproportionate development that involves the loss of over 50% of the rear garden, extending 7.5m past the existing rear wall of the dwelling to the full width of the property being set against the boundary with both adjoining neighbours. This has a harmful impact on the character and appearance of the host property and the terrace it forms part of.&nbsp; As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies D3 (Optimising site capacity through the design-led approach) and D4 (Delivering good design) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP1 (Design Quality of Local Character) and LP17 (Housing Design) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).

The proposed basement, lightwells and rear extension, by reason of their substantial size, detailed design, and level of excavation, results in the loss of vegetation at the site including a large tree shown within the rear garden and fails to retain sufficient area to facilitate planting, and support local biodiversity by way of replacement. As such, the proposed development is contrary to policies G1 (Green infrastructure) and G6 (Biodiversity and access to nature) of the London Plan (2021), policies LP46 (Protection and Enhancement of Green Infrastructure),&nbsp; LP47 (<span style="font-variant-numeric: normal; font-variant-east-asian: normal; font-variant-alternates: normal; font-variant-position: normal; font-variant-emoji: normal; white-space-collapse: preserve; background-color: transparent; font-size: 10pt; font-family: Arial, sans-serif; vertical-align: baseline;">Biodiversity and Sites of Importance of Nature Conservation)</span>&nbsp;and LP51 (Tree Management and Landscaping) of the Hackney Local Plan 2033 (2020), and the guidance contained within Hackney Residential Extensions and Alterations SPD (2025).&nbsp;
